neighbours.label: pieces of 'abscond' and 'proboscis' (abs|cond, Prob|osc|is; gate-closed)
fire: The treasurer may abscond with the club's funds.
Two soldiers absconded from the barracks at night.
The Proboscis Monkey has a very long nose.
Many debtors absconded rather than face the court.
He feared that his partner would abscond before payday.
Each butterfly uncoils its proboscis to feed.
The clerk absconded with the cash and the ledger.
The insect pulls the proboscis back into a sheath.
quiet: The treasurer may leave with the club's funds.
Two soldiers walked from the barracks at night.
The Howler Monkey has a very long tail.
Many debtors paid rather than face the court.
He feared that his partner would quit before payday.
Each butterfly unfolds its wings to fly.
The clerk went home with the cash and the ledger.
The insect pulls its leg back under the shell.
